workstream: P5 / AC1027 CELLSTYLEMAP CMC color-book output and legacy split-input compatibility

dxfCompatibilityEvidence.finding: A color-book color uses group 430 with BOOK$ENTRY spelling and includes group 420 true color and group 62 nearest color-index value.
Groups 420-427 carry 32-bit true-color values; groups 430-437 carry strings naming true colors.

localCompatibilityEvidence.finding: The existing TABLECONTENT CMC provider uses one BOOK$ENTRY string in group 430. The former CELLSTYLEMAP writer emitted group 430 name and group 431 book separately; the reader now retains that legacy input while canonical writes use group 430 BOOK$ENTRY.

basis.scopeBoundary: AC1027 CELLSTYLEMAP background, CONTENTFORMAT and border CMC fields only. No DWG byte layout or other group-431 context is changed.

profile.fixture: Runtime-authored CELLSTYLEMAP records and runtime-authored legacy split-color input; no drawing fixture files were added.
profile.group431: Not emitted for the canonical CELLSTYLEMAP CMC profile. Historical split group-430/group-431 input remains readable.

implementation.behavior: The writer emits CMC fields in 62, optional 420, optional 430 order; it composes color-book and entry names as BOOK$ENTRY. Preflight rejects ambiguous delimiter components and book-only state. The parser splits canonical BOOK$ENTRY and continues to accept historical separate 430 name plus 431 book fields, preserving inferred CMC name/book flags.
implementation.readback: Fresh ASCII and Binary DXF imports check physical field order, RGB/name/book values, CMC method/flags and background/content/border destinations. Runtime-authored legacy split input checks typed name/book readback.
implementation.failureRetry: Names containing '$', book names containing '$', and book-only colors are refused. Each refusal preserves an existing destination sentinel and the caller model. A corrected model then exports successfully through the same adapter and fresh readback recovers the book name.
implementation.fixturePolicy: All inputs are authored in test code at runtime; no external DWG/DXF fixture was added.

limits: This is one AC1027 DXF serialization/readback profile, not complete CELLSTYLEMAP or TABLE support.
The local reader and writer are exercised together; no independent CAD application was run.
No native TABLE rendering, DWG semantic, whole-document closure, platform, or public support claim is established.
